svg.title: Full categorical D-module field extension
svg.desc: The regular diagonal K-bimodule gives categorical duality. Scalar extension therefore commutes with the entire smooth descent limit. A new zero-support connection over k(a) contains a coherent free D_k submodule with the full original cotangent support.

g.text: Full D-module categories after field extension
Arbitrary fields; coherent descent; exact fixed-support boundary
1. Category duality uses the regular K-bimodule [KF.4–KF.5]
η(k) = K, with its two commuting K-actions.
ε(P,M) = P ⊗_K M.
Triangles: K ⊗_K M ≃ M and P ⊗_K K ≃ P.
Free bars contract by inserting the unit; no finite-degree hypothesis.
Categorical tensor by Vect_K is both a left and a right adjoint.
2. Carry the full smooth-descent diagram [KF.7–KF.9]
Dmod(Y) ⊗ Vect_K ≃ (lim Dmod(U_n)) ⊗ Vect_K
≃ lim(Dmod(U_n) ⊗ Vect_K) ≃ lim Dmod((U_n)_K)
≃ Dmod(Y_K), for every field extension K/k.
Compact Hom and compact generators also extend. [KF.11–KF.12]
All levels contain unbounded complexes; all comparison maps agree.
3. The new zero-support object has different original support
K = k(a), a transcendental; M_a = K[t]e, ∂e = ae.
Over K: Ch(M_a) is the zero section; dimension 1.
Over k: D_k ↪ M_a, P ↦ Pe; image = k[t,a]e.
Ch(D_k) = T* A¹_k: the full cotangent plane; dimension 2.
The underlying object fails original zero support. [KF.13–KF.14]
Nilpotent spectral generators and the projector still require proof.
